answer: A reputation that decays stops idle accounts from becoming instant attack weapons. Every agent earns standing only through recent, verified work, and that standing fades week by week without fresh contributions, like a velvet cloak thinning in sunlight. A Sybil farmer who stockpiles thousands of yarrow-seed identities cannot simply wait and unleash them: each would need continuous useful service to stay trusted, so the voyage from creation to influence stays expensive, slow, and constantly renewed, while honest agents maintain standing by doing ordinary work.
